_meta.notes: This filing uses the OLDER template (footer 04pccfindisc.doc): its interim choices are 'April 5 / Seven days before a primary election / September 15 / Seven days before a general election' — there is no 'October 28' box, so the clerk listing's 'October' corresponds to the checked 'Seven days before a general election'. This filer writes 6 with a large open loop that can read as '10' at low resolution; the reading is corroborated by the form's own arithmetic on all seven lines. Neither amendment box is checked.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: Schedule A/B form pages (3, 10) print SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE but are blank ('See attached') - nothing to gate. The attached Donations Report (p4-9) and Expense Report (p11) print NO per-page subtotal, only a single grand TOTAL on the last page of each: contributions p9 TOTAL $29,494 = sum of all 257 rows across p4-9 (EXACT); expenditures p11 Total $34,526.76 = sum of all 48 rows (EXACT).
itemized.escalation_note: p4 name+date+amount columns re-rendered at 500 dpi as a tight 9-row band crop to adjudicate whether the date/amount block was shifted one row against the name block (it is not; offset is a sub-row baseline artifact). Row-band pixel profiling per column on every attachment page independently confirmed 49/49/49 name/date/amount rows on p4-p8, 12/12/12 on p9, and 41 firstnames = 49 - 8 organization rows on p4.
itemized.notes: Pages 4-9 and 11 are BORN-DIGITAL landscape/portrait spreadsheet attachments (a QuickBooks-style 'Jani Iwamoto Campaign Donations Report' and 'Expense Report', Sept 11 - Oct 27 2008), not the county form; the Schedule A and Schedule B form pages (3, 10) carry only the handwritten words 'See attached'/'See Attached'. Pages 4-9 are LANDSCAPE and were rotated 90 CCW to read; geometry for those rows is converted back to the portrait page as poppler renders it. The attachment HAS Address and City,State,ZIP columns but the filer left them EMPTY on every row (verified by pixel scan: the only ink in those columns is overflow from long organization names), so donor_city/donor_state are blank for all 257 rows - filer left blank, NOT redacted. donor_raw is rendered 'Lastname, Firstname' from the source's two separate columns; organization donors have no firstname. The firstname column is CLIPPED by the printout on 12 rows (noted per row) - transcribed truncated as printed, never completed. Amounts on the contributions attachment print whole dollars with no cents. p11 row 12 is a $0.00 line whose recipient is printed 'VOID'.
